dialogues.speaker: Vert Jr.
dialogues.text: What do you think? It's your first time hearing this term, I'll bet!

dialogues.speaker: Vert Jr.
dialogues.text: My elder sister Rouge and I are both representatives of this profession!

dialogues.speaker: Vert Jr.
dialogues.text: We still haven't made a name for ourselves in the Court of Fontaine, sure, but many stores have sought out our help!

dialogues.speaker: Vert Jr.
dialogues.text: We offer comprehensive assistance to stores to improve their public brand, including but not limited to advertisements, news columns, short videos, large-scale events, etc.

dialogues.speaker: Vert Jr.
dialogues.text: For many stores, their excellent service is not reflected in their reputation. However, through the publicity we offer, we will bring their repute up to par with their ability.

dialogues.speaker: Vert Jr.
dialogues.text: According to the information we've collected, some restaurants in Liyue are suffering from this issue...

dialogues.speaker: Vert Jr.
dialogues.text: Most restaurants here offer delicious cuisine at reasonable prices, so they rarely have any competitors in the same price range. Residents only need to spend a small amount of Mora to enjoy a sumptuous feast.

dialogues.speaker: Vert Jr.
dialogues.text: However, more high-end food and beverage brands are needed... After all, even chefs require the support of a brand image.

dialogues.speaker: Vert Jr.
dialogues.text: If all restaurants operated on a small scale, the culinary profession would be seen as tons of work for little money. Few would be willing to take up the culinary arts.

dialogues.speaker: Vert Jr.
dialogues.text: If this profession is to have a future, we'll also need outfits that target the wealthy, earn big, and pay chefs handsomely...

dialogues.speaker: Vert Jr.
dialogues.text: This high-low combination will allow the general public to enjoy delicious food without worry. It would also be respectable to be a chef, and you'd be paid proportionately to your skill.

dialogues.speaker: Vert Jr.
dialogues.text: Maybe I can help improve this situation... I'll need to get a better understanding of Liyue's food industry first, though.

dialogues.speaker: Vert Jr.
dialogues.text: Best to start our research from Yilong Wharf before gradually expanding outward...
